item.subject: science
item.stem: Arjun, a Class 7 student in Pune, notices that his voice has become hoarse, pimples have appeared on his face, and hair has started growing under his arms. His classmate Meera has grown taller but has no pimples yet. Their teacher asks the class to choose the correct statement about these changes.

options.A: These changes are signs of a disease, so both students should take medicine.
options.B: These changes are abnormal because they do not look the same in both students.
options.C: Every student in Class 7 must show the same changes at the same time.
options.D: These are normal adolescent changes, and their timing and extent can differ from person to person.
